---
title: "What does it weigh, and where does it balance?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

Each part's traced area times the sheet's areal density, placed at the traced
centroid of its plan shape, summed with `MassProperties` so the balance point is
computed rather than assumed.

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed
Nothing beyond the sheet weight, which was given. Glue is not modelled at all —
it lies forward of the structure CG, so every gram of it reduces the ballast
needed rather than adding to it.
:::

```{python}
mp = mass_properties()

parts = [
    ("wing",                    S_w,        S_w * sigma,        x_le_w + 0.0450),
    ("stabilizer",              S_h,        S_h * sigma,        x_le_h + 0.0318),
    ("fin",                     S_v,        S_v * sigma,        x_te_v - fin_c[0] + 0.0207),
    ("fuselage, 2 laminations", 2 * S_fus,  2 * S_fus * sigma,  0.1163),
]
x_np = neutral_point()
```

**Answer.** `{python} f"{mp.mass*1e3:.2f}"` g, balancing
`{python} f"{mp.x_cg*1e3:.1f}"` mm aft of the nose — which is
`{python} f"{(mp.x_cg - x_np)*1e3:.1f}"` mm *behind* its own neutral point at
`{python} f"{x_np*1e3:.1f}"` mm, so it will not fly as built. That is the whole
reason ballast is needed, and it follows from where the mass sits rather than
from any aerodynamic subtlety: the tail surfaces are only
`{python} f"{(S_h + S_v)/(S_w + S_h + S_v)*100:.0f}"`% of the flying-surface
area but sit at the end of a `{python} f"{l_fus*100:.1f}"` cm fuselage, and the
fuselage plate itself — `{python} f"{2*S_fus*sigma/mp.mass*100:.0f}"`% of the
structure — is the only heavy thing forward of the wing.

At `{python} f"{sigma*1e3:.1f}"` g/m², the sheet is what sets all of this: mass
scales with traced area alone, so it is the one quantity in this chapter that
carries no aerodynamic assumption.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-mass
#| tbl-cap: "The mass build-up. Station is the traced centroid of each plan shape, measured aft of the nose; the balance point is their mass-weighted mean."
import pandas as pd

pd.DataFrame({
    "part": [p[0] for p in parts] + ["structure"],
    "foam area [cm²]": [f"{p[1]*1e4:.1f}" for p in parts]
                       + [f"{sum(p[1] for p in parts)*1e4:.1f}"],
    "mass [g]": [f"{p[2]*1e3:.2f}" for p in parts] + [f"{mp.mass*1e3:.2f}"],
    "station [mm]": [f"{p[3]*1e3:.1f}" for p in parts] + [f"{mp.x_cg*1e3:.1f}"],
    "share [%]": [f"{p[2]/mp.mass*100:.0f}" for p in parts] + ["100"],
}).style.hide(axis="index")
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
show_source(neutral_point)
```
